Àte ŋu amɔ agble tɔxɛwo katã to woƒe ŋkɔwo kple asixɔxɔwo ŋɔŋlɔ dzi. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: Field1 == Value1. Dzesi: Ne teƒe gbɔlo le agblewo alo asixɔxɔwo me la, ele be nàtsɔ wo ade kaklã ɖeka me. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Be woatsɔ asi adzo le dziɖudzesi ɖeka (' \/) ŋu la, àte ŋu azã \. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: Field1 == I\'m. Àte ŋu atsɔ nɔnɔme geɖewo afli ɖekae hã. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Zi geɖe la, woɖea dɔwɔnadzesiwo katã me tso miame yi nuɖusime. Àte ŋu atrɔ̃ ɖoɖo la to kaklãwo deɖe me dzi. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Àte ŋu adi nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe agblewo hã to regex zazã me: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-leo: Paste a Leo outline (.leo file). Top-level nodes become lists, their children become cards with the node body as the description, and deeper nodes become checklists. Marked nodes import as done.

globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Woate ŋu aɖe dɔwɔnadzesi geɖewo afia.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Woƒoa dɔwɔnadzesi siwo sɔ ƒu kple *OR*. Woagbugbɔ kaɖi siwo sɔ kple nɔnɔmeawo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` agbugbɔ kaɖi siwo le xexlẽdzesi ɖesiaɖe si ƒe ŋkɔ nye *Blocked* alo *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Wokɔa dɔwɔnadzesi siwo me ɖe vovo kple *AND*. Kaɖi siwo sɔ kple dɔwɔnadzesi vovovoawo katã ko woagbugbɔ. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` gbugbɔa kaɖi siwo le xexlẽdzesi *Available* me kple dzesi *red* ko.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Woate ŋu aɖe ŋkeke afia abe blibo si le 0 dzi alo le 0 te, alo woazã `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` alo `__predicate_year__` na ɣeyiɣi si li fifia.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Nuŋɔŋlɔ didi mekpɔ ŋɔŋlɔdzesi gã alo sue gbɔ o.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Le gɔmedzedze me womedi kaɖi siwo le nudzraɖoƒe o.

render-links-as-plain-text-description: Ne womɔe la, kadodowo katã (markdown kadodowo abe [label](url) kple HTML gɔŋgɔ <a href> tagwo siaa) dzena ɣesiaɣi abe nuŋɔŋlɔ bɔbɔe si womate ŋu azi dzi o ene le nuŋɔŋlɔ kɔkɔe ƒe agble ɖesiaɖe me (kpekpeɖeŋu kple kaɖi ƒe ŋkɔwo, numeɖeɖewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo, ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo, kple bubuwo). Esia xea mɔ na kadodo siwo ate ŋu ablu ame. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ, eya ta woate ŋu azi kadodowo dzi.
always-show-code-as-text: Fia code katã ɣesiaɣi abe nuŋɔŋlɔ bɔbɔe ene
always-show-code-as-text-description: Ne womɔe la, womafia nuŋɔŋlɔ kɔkɔe abe markdown alo HTML ene gbeɖe o: wofiaa nutoƒe bliboa ɣesiaɣi abe nuŋɔŋlɔ bɔbɔe ene le nuŋɔŋlɔ kɔkɔe ƒe agble ɖesiaɖe me (kpekpeɖeŋu kple kaɖi ƒe ŋkɔwo, numeɖeɖewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo, ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo, kple bubuwo). Esia ɖea emenya siwo woɣla — HTML nyaŋuɖoɖowo (<!-- -->), markdown kadodowo ƒe yiteƒe, JavaScript kple code bubu ɖesiaɖe — fia, ale code katã dzena ɣesiaɣi, womate ŋu azi dzi o, eye mele dɔ wɔm o. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ, eya ta wofiaa markdown abe ale si wòle ene.
disable-all-import: Xe mɔ na nu tsɔtsɔ vavã katã
disable-all-import-description: Ne womɔe la, woxe mɔ na nu tsɔtsɔ vavã ƒe dɔwɔnawo katã: kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ vavã tso WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea kple Forgejo, kple kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe evelia wɔwɔ. Woɣla nu tsɔtsɔ vavã ƒe menu tiatiwo eye dɔdzikpɔla la gbea nu tsɔtsɔ vavã ƒe biabia ɖesiaɖe. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-all-export: Xe mɔ na nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go katã
disable-all-export-description: Ne womɔe la, woxe mɔ na nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go ƒe dɔwɔnawo katã: kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go abe WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, alo yi NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, kple nusi wokpe ɖe eŋu ɖeka ƒe nuɖeɖego. Woɣla nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go ƒe menu tiatiwo eye dɔdzikpɔla la gbea nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go ƒe biabia ɖesiaɖe. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-import-avatars: Xe mɔ na nɔnɔmetata tsɔtsɔ vavã
disable-import-avatars-description: Ne womɔe la, womatsɔ nɔnɔmetatawo (zazãla ƒe ŋutinya nɔnɔmetatawo) ava eme gbeɖe o. Esia kpɔa WeKan JSON nu tsɔtsɔ vavã, Trello nu tsɔtsɔ vavã, kple nɔnɔmetata ɖoɖo ɖe gotagome dzenawo ŋutinya kpɔkpɔlawo ŋu le gegeɖeme (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2) gbɔ. Wogatsɔ ŋkɔwo kple nyatakaka bubuwo ava eme; nɔnɔmetatawo ko woadzo le ŋu. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-export-avatars: Xe mɔ na nɔnɔmetata tsɔtsɔ ɖe go
disable-export-avatars-description: Ne womɔe la, womatsɔ nɔnɔmetatawo (zazãla ƒe ŋutinya nɔnɔmetatawo) ade kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go (WeKan JSON kple CSV nuɖeɖego) me gbeɖe o. Woagatsɔ zazãlaŋkɔwo kple nyatakaka bubuwo aɖe go; nɔnɔmetatawo ko woagblẽ ɖi. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
anonymize-import-users: Ɣla zazãla siwo wotsɔ va eme ƒe dzenawo
anonymize-import-users-description: Ne womɔe la, WeKan JSON kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ vavã trɔ̃a zazãla ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ va eme ƒe zazãlaŋkɔ, ŋkɔ bliboa kple ŋkɔwo ƒe dzesi gbãtɔwo wozua xexlẽla ƒe teƒenɔlawo (user1, user2, ...), gblẽa eƒe nɔnɔmetata ɖi, eye wòŋlɔa @username yɔyɔwo (kple ame-si-bia / ame-si-de-dɔ agblewo) yeye le kaɖi kple nyaŋuɖoɖo siwo wotsɔ va eme me. Womadzra zazãla ŋutɔ ƒe dzenawo tso nutoƒe kpekpeɖeŋu la ɖo o. Nya "user" dzea ame si le nu tsɔm vavã la ƒe gbe yome. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
anonymize-export-users: Ɣla zazãla siwo wotsɔ ɖe go ƒe dzenawo
anonymize-export-users-description: Ne womɔe la, kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go trɔ̃a zazãla ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ ɖe go ƒe zazãlaŋkɔ, ŋkɔ bliboa kple ŋkɔwo ƒe dzesi gbãtɔwo wozua xexlẽla ƒe teƒenɔlawo (user1, user2, ...), gblẽa eƒe nɔnɔmetata ɖi, eye wòŋlɔa @username yɔyɔwo (kple ame-si-bia / ame-si-de-dɔ agblewo) yeye le kaɖi kple nyaŋuɖoɖo ƒe emenyawo me. Agbalẽ si wotsɔ ɖe go makɔ zazãla ŋutɔ ƒe dzenawo o. Nya "user" dzea ame si le nu tsɔm ɖe go la ƒe gbe yome. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
anonymize-account: Ɣla zazãla siwo wotsɔ va eme ƒe dzenawo
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Ne womɔe la, kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go trɔ̃a zazãla ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ ɖe go ƒe zazãlaŋkɔ, ŋkɔ bliboa kple ŋkɔwo ƒe dzesi gbãtɔwo wozua xexlẽla ƒe teƒenɔlawo (user1, user2, ...), gblẽa eƒe nɔnɔmetata ɖi, eye wòŋlɔa @username yɔyɔwo (kple ame-si-bia / ame-si-de-dɔ agblewo) yeye le kaɖi kple nyaŋuɖoɖo ƒe emenyawo me. Agbalẽ si wotsɔ ɖe go makɔ zazãla ŋutɔ ƒe dzenawo o. Nya "user" dzea ame si le nu tsɔm ɖe go la ƒe gbe yome. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-activities-description: Ne womɔe la, womede dɔwɔwɔ ƒe nyadzraɖoƒe ƒe emenyawo gbeɖe o, eye womafia wo le teƒe aɖeke o (kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe gbɔgbɔmenu kple kaɖi ƒe dɔwɔwɔ tab). Womadzra ame si wɔ nu kple nusi wòwɔ ƒe ŋutinya aɖeke ɖo o. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-notifications: Xe mɔ na nyanyanana wo katã
disable-notifications-description: Ne womɔe la, WeKan maɖo ŋudzɔdzɔ ƒe nyanyanana (le app me, email alo subɔsubɔ bubuwo) gbeɖe na dɔwɔwɔ ɖesiaɖe o. Woate ŋu agade dɔwɔwɔwo (ne womexe mɔ na wo le tame o); nyanyanana wo ko wotu ɖi. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-watch-description: Ne womɔe la, woxe mɔ na ŋudzɔdzɔ ƒe dɔwɔna — zazãlawo mate ŋu aŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe kpekpeɖeŋu, xexlẽdzesi alo kaɖiwo ŋu be woaxɔ nyanyanana o, eye woagbe ŋudzɔdzɔ ƒe afɔɖeɖe tɔtrɔ ƒe kpɔkpɔ ɖesiaɖe. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
backup-description: Dzra Nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu, Nɔnɔmetatawo kple/alo Nyatakakawo (nuŋɔŋlɔ-nɔnɔme ƒe nudzraɖoƒewo katã siwo menye nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu alo nɔnɔmetatawo o) ɖo ɖe megbe. Wotsɔa .zip la yia nudzraɖoƒe si wotia la gbɔ enumake — ɣeyiɣi kpui ƒe agbalẽ aɖeke meli o — abe backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip ene, si me YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars kple /data le. Alilikpo nudzraɖoƒewo (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) zãa dzenawo si woɖo le woƒe nudzraɖoƒe tabwo me.
backup-scope-description: Mɔ̃ bliboa, alo Habɔbɔ ɖeka. Habɔbɔ ƒe megbenudzraɖoɖo kɔa eƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo kple nusiwo katã le wo dzi, si me kpekpeɖeŋu mawo ƒe nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu le — gake zazãla ƒe akɔntawo kple mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖowo mele eme o, elabena habɔbɔ ɖesiaɖe ma wo. Habɔbɔ ƒe megbenudzraɖoɖo gbugbɔɖoɖo ŋlɔa ɖe kpekpeɖeŋu siwo Habɔbɔ ma nye tɔ ko dzi.
theme-override-all-tenants: Tɔtrɔ si wɔa dɔ na amedzro siwo katã
backup-schedule: Megbenudzraɖoɖo siwo woɖo le ɣeyiɣi dzi

Ewɔa dɔ kple megbenudzraɖoɖo si woɖo ɣeyiɣi na, si dzraa nuwo katã ɖo.

continuous-backup-target: Nudzraɖoƒe si woaɖo ɖe (mɔ blibo, le disk bubu, nudzraɖoƒe si wokpɔna ɖekae le kadodo dzi alo rclone nudzraɖoƒe si wode kpe ɖe eŋu)
continuous-backup-include: Dzra nu siawo ɖo ɖe megbe
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (le ɣeyiɣi ma ke me, tɔtrɔ ɖe sia ɖe)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: SQLite ƒe axawo (axawo siwo trɔ le ɣeyiɣi ɖe sia ɖe me)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (ɖoɖo si nàte ŋu atia ade kɔmpiuta me)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe mɔ̃ aɖeke mate ŋu awɔ dɔ le server sia dzi o

continuous-backup-encrypt: Tsɔ kod ɣaɣla tsɔ ɣla megbenudzraɖoɖo la (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Kod ɣaɣla ƒe safui ƒe agbalẽ (mɔ blibo le nudzraɖoƒe si woaɖo ɖe la godo; dzesi 64 le xexlẽdzesi ƒe ɖoɖo si ƒe gɔme nye 16 me alo nya ɣaɣla si me dzesi 16 alo esi wu nenema le). Dzra kɔpi ɖeka ɖo: ne agbalẽ sia mele asi o la, womate ŋu agbugbɔ megbenudzraɖoɖo la ava eme o.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Megadɔ ɖe afi aɖeke o (nudzraɖoƒe si woaɖo ɖe la ko)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Nudzraɖoƒe le nudzraɖo tsesi la me
continuous-backup-fetched: Wohe agbalẽwo tso alilikpo la me
continuous-backup-errors: Vodadawo le ɣeyiɣi kpui si va yi me
continuous-backup-restore-points: Ɣeyiɣiwo siwo woate ŋu agbugbɔ aɖo te
continuous-backup-restore-to: Gbugbɔ ɖo te le (ŋkeke kple ɣeyiɣi)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: SQLite nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe agbalẽ (wowɔe ɖe megbenudzraɖoɖo la gbɔ, womagbugbɔ aŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ si wole zãm la dzi gbeɖe o)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Zã SQLite nyatakakadzraɖoƒe si wogbugbɔ wɔ la ne ɖoɖo la gbugbɔ dze egɔme le ɣeyiɣi si gbɔna me (woadzra nyatakakadzraɖoƒe xoxo si woɖɔli la ɖo)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Gbugbɔ nudzraɖoɖo ƒe ƒome si wotia la ɖo te le ɣeyiɣi si wotia la me? Megbenudzraɖoɖo si yi edzi ɣesiaɣi la atɔ vie esi gbugbɔɖoɖote la le edzi yim.
continuous-backup-saved: Wodzra megbenudzraɖoɖo si yi edzi ɣesiaɣi ƒe ɖoɖowo ɖo
backup-restore-add-missing: Tsɔ nyatakaka siwo bu ko kpe ɖe eŋu
backup-restore-select-first: Tia megbenudzraɖoɖo tso xexlẽdzesi la me gbã.
backup-restore-confirm: Gbugbɔ megbenudzraɖoɖo si wotia la ɖo? Woaŋlɔ nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu/nɔnɔmetatawo ɖe agbalẽ ƒe mɔ̃ dzi kple nyatakakawo ɖe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe me le mɔ si wotia la nu.

gcs-key-filename-description: Menye se o: mɔ si yia subɔsubɔ akɔnta JSON key agbalẽ gbɔ le dɔdzikpɔla dzi.
gcs-credentials-description: Menye se o: tsɔ subɔsubɔ akɔnta JSON key de afisia. Gblẽe ɖi gbɔlo be nàzã key agbalẽ alo dzenawo gɔmedzedze.
gcs-permissions-note: Na WeKan ƒe subɔsubɔ akɔnta xexlẽ/ŋɔŋlɔ mɔ le bucket dzi: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → wò bucket → Permissions → Grant access. Le "New principals" me, tsɔ subɔsubɔ akɔnta email la de afisia — "client_email" asixɔxɔ tso wò JSON key me — emegbe tia dɔdeasi "Storage Object Admin" eye nàdzra ɖo.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Gblẽe ɖi gbɔlo be nàdzra asixɔxɔ si li fifia ɖo.

s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → wò bucket → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → wò bucket ƒe ŋkɔ (alo Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → wò zazãla → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → tia zazã ƒe nɔnɔme 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Wofiaa abe 'Access key ID' ene.

azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → wò akɔnta → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → wò akɔnta → Data storage → Containers → wò nugbagbe (alo + Container be nàwɔ ɖeka).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → dɔtaɖodzinu tiatia le tame → wò dɔtaɖodzinu ƒe ID (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → wò bucket ƒe ŋkɔ (alo Create be nàwɔ ɖeka).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Mɔ le WeKan dɔdzikpɔla dzi yi subɔsubɔ akɔnta JSON key agbalẽ si wotsɔ ɖe anyi (si wowɔ le ete). Zã esia ALO tsɔ JSON de agble si le ete me.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → wò subɔsubɔ akɔnta → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (etsɔa agbalẽ la ɖe anyi). Tsɔ eƒe emenyawo de afisia, alo dzra agbalẽ la ɖo eye nàɖo eƒe mɔ le tame.
